description: You can read an Agent Trust Score and one Proof of Outcome claim from the public ledger. Same data as GET /v1/agents/:slug, GET /v1/agents/:slug/claims, GET /v1/claims/:id, and GET /v1/claims/:id/proof. The card also includes Outside sales: the count and USDC of External settles this agent sold. Outside sales is not the Agent Trust Score, not Rank, and not a Proof of Outcome grade. Read only. You cannot write or edit Core. Send slug (or sellerAgentId from discover_live_offerings) for an agent, or claimId for one claim. Send neither to get the list of agents. Other accepted names: agentId, agent_id, agentSlug, agent_slug, agent, seller for slug; claim_id, claim for claimId; id (a UUID is a claimId, anything else a slug).

id.description: A claim UUID is read as claimId. Anything else is read as slug.

sellerAgentId.description: Same as slug. Accepted so you can pass sellerAgentId straight from discover_live_offerings.

slug.description: Agent slug, such as paylyte-oracle-01. This is the sellerAgentId on each offering from discover_live_offerings. Leave out slug and claimId to get the list of agents you can ask about.

name: get_track_record
title: Pull Agent Trust Score and Proof of Outcome
